notes: Get a T-casual 10-ride metro ticket; the Aerobús from Plaça Catalunya takes 35 minutes. The city is walkable, and Montjuïc has a cable car and funicular.
Sagrada Família, Park Güell, Casa Batlló and the Picasso Museum: timed online tickets are ESSENTIAL. For the Sagrada Família, book months ahead because of the 2026 centenary.
Summers are 28-32°C, with beaches and terraces. In August many local shops close for holiday; the Font Màgica runs Thursday to Sunday at 21:00.
The set lunch (menú del día) costs 13-18 EUR, about half the price of dinner. Eating standing at a tapas bar is cheap; dinner starts after 21:00.
Pickpocketing on the Rambla and the metro is among the worst in Europe. Keep your bag in front of you and never leave your phone on the table.
Catalan and Spanish are spoken; 'bon dia' is enough. For a tip, round up the bill.

stops.name: Sagrada Família
stops.tips: Gaudí's basilica. Book timed tickets online weeks ahead (centenary year 2026, 26-40 EUR); the tower costs extra. At 09:00 the light hits the stained glass.

stops.name: Casa Batlló
stops.tips: The house with the dragon-back roof. Book online, morning slot.

stops.name: Casa Milà La Pedrera
stops.tips: Admire the wavy facade from the street; the interior is an optional 28 EUR.

stops.name: Cerveseria Catalana
stops.tips: A classic Eixample tapas bar. Order montaditos (small toasts) and gambas; the queue is short at 13:30.

stops.name: Passeig de Gràcia
stops.tips: A modernist boulevard lined with shops.

backups.name: Tapas 24
backups.tips: Carles Abellan's tapas spot; try the bikini sandwich.

backups.name: Recinte Modernista Sant Pau
backups.tips: A modernist hospital complex near the Sagrada Família. Quieter than Casa Batlló.

stops.name: Barcelona Cathedral
stops.tips: A Gothic cathedral with a cloister courtyard of geese. Free entry during the morning Mass.

stops.name: Barri Gòtic Streets
stops.tips: Plaça Sant Felip Neri, the Roman columns (MUHBA Temple d'August, free) and the Bisbe bridge.

stops.name: La Boqueria
stops.tips: The market on La Rambla. Eat squid with eggs at the El Quim or Bar Pinotxo counter; best before 10:00.

stops.name: El Born Santa Maria del Mar
stops.tips: The Cathedral of the Sea, plain and elegant Gothic.

stops.name: Picasso Museum
stops.tips: Early-period Picasso. Free on Thursday evenings; book online.

backups.name: El Xampanyet
backups.tips: Serving cava and anchovies since 1929. Standing only, next to the Picasso Museum.

backups.name: Palau de la Música Catalana
backups.tips: Tour of the modernist concert hall, as an alternative to the Picasso Museum.

stops.name: Park Güell
stops.tips: The mosaic salamander and the wavy bench. Timed tickets online (10 EUR); the first slot at 08:30 is quiet.

stops.name: Bunkers del Carmel
stops.tips: A former anti-aircraft hilltop with Barcelona's best free 360° view.

stops.name: Gràcia Plaça del Sol
stops.tips: A village-like neighbourhood of squares and terraces.

stops.name: La Pubilla Gràcia
stops.tips: Catalan set lunch in Gràcia. Closed on Sundays.

stops.name: Casa Vicens
stops.tips: Gaudí's first house, with tile and palm-leaf motifs, in Gràcia.

backups.name: Bar Bodega Quimet Gràcia
backups.tips: Vermouth and tinned-seafood tapas; a local favourite.

backups.name: Hospital de Sant Pau
backups.tips: A modernist hospital, as an alternative to Casa Vicens.

stops.name: MNAC Museu Nacional
stops.tips: Romanesque frescoes in a palace building. The steps give city views, and the terrace is free.

stops.name: Fundació Joan Miró
stops.tips: Miró's works in Sert's white building.

stops.name: Montjuïc Cable Car
stops.tips: A cable car up to the castle with sea views.

stops.name: Montjuïc Castle Cafe
stops.tips: Lunch in the castle courtyard with a view of the port.

stops.name: Font Màgica Montjuïc
stops.tips: The Magic Fountain's music-and-light show (summer Thursday to Sunday at 21:00). It may be closed for maintenance in winter, so check first.

backups.name: Quimet & Quimet Poble Sec
backups.tips: A legendary tinned-seafood tapas bar in Poble Sec. Standing only.

backups.name: Montjuïc Olympic Stadium
backups.tips: The 1992 stadium, as an alternative to the cable car.

stops.name: Barceloneta Beach
stops.tips: The city beach. Quiet in the morning, sunloungers 8 EUR, sea around 25°C in summer.

stops.name: La Cova Fumada
stops.tips: The birthplace of the bomba (potato croquette). No menu, cash only, full by 13:00.

stops.name: Barceloneta Seafront Walk to the W Hotel
stops.tips: A palm-lined seafront stroll that passes Frank Gehry's fish sculpture.

stops.name: Port Vell and Maremagnum
stops.tips: The old harbour, with the Rambla de Mar bridge.

stops.name: Port Cable Car
stops.tips: The red cable car over the harbour to Montjuïc, with views of sea and city.

backups.name: Can Paixano La Xampanyeria
backups.tips: Cava and sandwiches. Standing only, and cheap.

backups.name: Museu d'Història de Catalunya
backups.tips: A history museum in a port warehouse, with a terrace cafe.

stops.name: Montserrat Monastery
stops.tips: Train plus rack railway takes 1.5 hours (about 50 EUR combined ticket). The Black Madonna sits on the serrated mountain; the boys' choir (Escolania) sings at 13:00.

stops.name: Sant Joan Funicular
stops.tips: A funicular to the summit, with walking trails.

stops.name: Montserrat Sant Joan Walk
stops.tips: A flat 1-hour walk among the rocks with views over Catalonia.

stops.name: Montserrat Restaurant Abat Cisneros
stops.tips: The monastery hotel's restaurant, serving a Catalan lunch.

stops.name: Montserrat Market Stalls
stops.tips: Farmers' stalls selling mató (fresh goat's cheese) and honey.

backups.name: Santa Cova
backups.tips: A path to the cave where the Madonna was found, as an alternative to Sant Joan.

days.theme: Rambla morning and a gentle farewell

stops.name: La Rambla Morning Walk
stops.tips: Walk the Rambla before the crowds arrive, past the Miró mosaic and the flower stalls.

stops.name: Palau Güell
stops.tips: Gaudí's city mansion, with its rooftop chimneys.

stops.name: Granja Viader
stops.tips: Hot chocolate and churros since 1870, in the dairy where Cacaolat was born.

stops.name: Plaça Reial
stops.tips: A palm-filled square with Gaudí lampposts, ideal for a farewell photo. The Aerobús leaves from Plaça Catalunya.

backups.name: MACBA Raval
backups.tips: Contemporary art and skateboarders, as an alternative to Palau Güell.
